semantics.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-run metrics, n=2 per controller; no significance claim
semantics.tilt: Angle between endpoint local +Z and frozen H0/world vertical; mean over samples
semantics.swing: RMS angular distance from each axis to normalized mean axis of that run/window
semantics.velocity: Derivative of endpoint-minus-torso IMU position in fixed H0, demeaned per window; not absolute translation
semantics.acceleration: 3D vector norm RMS, gravity removed; angular metrics use full 3D rotation
semantics.hold: Learning prediction ablation; measured disturbances, gravity and moving-base inverse dynamics retained
semantics.measurement: Joint/IMU model reconstruction; not external optical or liquid-surface ground truth
semantics.timing: MPC through timing enqueue; PID through command enqueue; both exclude device actuation delay
